title: 第8章 筑台拜将
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

韩信的前半生是草根逆袭的极致样本，他的成功既源于萧何的识人之明、刘邦的用人之胆，更离不开乱世中“唯才是举”的特殊环境。然而这场逆袭也埋下悲剧伏笔，一个从屈辱中崛起的枭雄注定难容于太平年代的权谋旋涡，登坛拜将的荣耀终将化作未央宫的鲜血。但这一切已远非那个钻过裤裆的少年所能预料了。

韩信的一生跌宕起伏，充满传奇，身世成谜的韩信身上有很多谜团，他的身份就是其中之一，《史记·淮阴侯列传》说他是淮阴人，这恐怕只是他的出生地，不是他的祖籍。有一个人跟韩信的身世更为相似，那就是韩王韩信。楚国本土没有韩氏贵族，出现在楚国的韩姓贵族基本只能来自一个国家——韩国。不是本地贵族，自然就得不到本地家族势力的庇护。既不是本地人，又得不到地方豪强的支持，推择为吏这种好事自然也就轮不到韩信头上。

《史记》记述韩信身为布衣。因为家贫，连做小吏的资格都没有，这点和刘邦又可以对比，刘邦正是因为家境殷实才能当上亭长。

《史记》还说韩信不会做商贾，生活陷入贫困，已经到了吃不上饭的地步。韩信只能厚着脸皮到处找熟人蹭饭，导致大家都很讨厌他。

南昌亭长看他可怜，好心邀请他去家里吃饭。他倒好，一点不客气，一连数月在人家白吃白喝。搞得亭长老婆十分火大，就没见过这么厚脸皮的人！又不好意思直言赶他走，于是天不亮就做饭，做好就在床上悄悄吃，也不告诉他。等到天亮，到了正常吃饭的时间，韩信又准时前往，人家不给他准备饭食也不理他。

韩信情商再低也明白人家的用意了，韩信很生气，但后果一点也不严重。韩信气呼呼离开了亭长的家，就这么结束了几个月的蹭饭生涯。

韩信跑到城外的河边钓鱼，但钓鱼不等于捕鱼，加上韩信可能也不怎么会钓，经常饥一顿饱一顿。同在河边漂洗浣纱的大妈们经常看到他在河边饿的饥肠辘辘却还在那里坚持不懈的垂钓。其中一位大妈看他可怜，就把自己的饭分给韩信吃。

之后的几十天，这位大妈天天给韩信带饭。韩信深受感动，对大妈说：“我将来发迹，必定重重报答您！”

谁知大妈听了这话，不喜反怒说：“大丈夫不能自食其力，也不知羞愧。我是可怜你们这些公子王孙才带饭给你吃。谁要你的报答！”

淮阴当地的不良少年知道韩信孤苦无依，就故意欺负他。有个在当地做屠夫的市井泼皮就在街头闹市公然挑衅：“别看你小子高大壮硕，平日里还喜好佩刀弄剑，其实就是个怯懦的胆小鬼！”

这个屠夫当众放话：“韩信，你要是有胆量就拿剑刺我；要是没胆，就从我的胯下钻过去！”

韩信凝视着面前这位挑衅的屠夫，看了他很久，到底也没拔剑杀人，真的就匍匐在地，从这位恶屠的胯下钻了过去。所有人都嘲笑韩信胆小怯懦、丢人现眼。

Page (1/3)

The first half of Han Xin's life was the ultimate example of grassroots counterattack. His success stemmed not only from Xiao He's ability to recognize people, Liu Bang's courage in employing people, but also from the special environment of "meritocracy" in troubled times.However, this counterattack also laid the foundation for tragedy. A hero who rose from humiliation was destined to be difficult to tolerate in the maelstrom of power in the peaceful era. The glory of worshiping the general will eventually turn into the blood of Weiyang Palace.But all this was far beyond what the boy who had penetrated his crotch could have expected.

Han Xin's life was full of ups and downs and full of legends. There are many mysteries about Han Xin, whose life experience is a mystery. His identity is one of them. "Historical Records: Biography of the Marquis of Huaiyin" says that he was from Huaiyin. This is probably just his birthplace, not his ancestral home.There is a person whose life experience is more similar to Han Xin, and that is Han Xin, King of Han.There are no Han nobles in Chu State, and the Han nobles who appear in Chu State can basically only come from one country - South Korea.If you are not a local noble, you will naturally not be protected by local family forces.Since he was not a local and could not get the support of local powerful people, it was natural that Han Xin would not be able to do such a good thing as being elected as an official.

"Historical Records" records that Han Xin was a commoner.Because his family was poor, he was not even qualified to be a minor official. This can be compared with Liu Bang. Liu Bang became the chief of the pavilion precisely because of his wealthy family.

"Historical Records" also said that Han Xin could not be a merchant, and his life fell into poverty, reaching the point where he could not afford to eat.Han Xin could only shamelessly look for acquaintances to feed him, causing everyone to hate him.

The director of the pavilion in Nanchang felt sorry for him and kindly invited him to his home for dinner.On the other hand, he was not polite at all, and he ate and drank freely at other people's houses for several months.This made the pavilion elder's wife very angry. She had never seen such a shameless person!I was too embarrassed to tell him to leave, so I cooked before dawn and ate in bed secretly without telling him.When it was daybreak and it was time for normal meals, Han Xin went there on time. People ignored him without preparing a meal for him.

No matter how low his emotional intelligence was, Han Xin understood what others were trying to do. Han Xin was very angry, but the consequences were not serious at all.Han Xin left the pavilion director's house angrily, thus ending his career of working as a slut for several months.

Han Xin went to the river outside the city to fish, but fishing is not the same as fishing. In addition, Han Xin may not be very good at fishing, so he often eats when he is hungry and full.The aunts who were rinsing yarn by the river often saw him fishing there despite being hungry.One of the aunts saw that he was pitiful, so she gave Han Xin her meal.

In the next few dozen days, this aunt brought Han Xin food every day.Han Xin was deeply moved and said to his aunt: "When I become successful in the future, I will definitely repay you!"

Unexpectedly, after hearing this, the aunt was not happy and said angrily: "A man can't support himself, and he has no shame. I brought you food out of pity for you, sons and grandsons. Who wants you to repay me!"

The local bad boys in Huaiyin knew that Han Xin was lonely and helpless, so they deliberately bullied him.A local gangster who was a butcher publicly challenged him on the street: "Even though you are tall and strong, and you like to wield swords, you are actually a cowardly coward!"

The butcher said in public: "Han Xin, if you have the guts, stab me with your sword; if you don't, get under my crotch!"

Han Xin stared at the provocative butcher in front of him. After looking at him for a long time, he did not draw his sword to kill. He actually knelt on the ground and got under the evil butcher's crotch.Everyone laughed at Han Xin for being cowardly and embarrassing.
